Writing Practice

Paste the words you are learning. Each card shows the pinyin and the English, and you write the hanzi in the box, one stroke at a time. Check tells you whether the shape and the stroke order are right.

Your word list

One word per line, like 苹果 | píngguǒ | apple. Tabs and commas work as separators, so a two-column export from Quizlet or a spreadsheet pastes in as it is. If a line has only hanzi, the pinyin is filled in for you.

Learning mode

Checks each stroke as you write it, and after Show me how it offers a Fix it button that swaps your wrong strokes for the right ones.

Erase one stroke: with a stylus, hold the side button and rub over it; with a mouse, right-click and drag over it.

Know it and Still learning are remembered in this browser, per word.

Enter check · H help · ⌫ undo · P practice · ← still learning · → know it
